name: zone-radius-extension-form-inside-root
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. A roadside-unit CAM with one zone (radius 100, protectedZoneID 5). Input built by hand: protectedZoneRadius (INTEGER (1..255, ...), bit 275) written in the extension form (bit 1, length 1, octet 64) though 100 lies in the root; accepted (ruling 7 of 0.19). Expect: the encoding of both codecs, radius in the root form (bit 0, 99 in 8 bits), 311 bits. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
